result.instructions: Tools for Pingboard, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who reports to Alex Morgan, and which groups are they in?"; "List the people in the Engineering group with their job titles."; "Which users are out of office this week?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Pingboard data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run pingboard_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run pingboard_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run pingboard_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. pingboard_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: pingboard_get_company
tools.title: Get the company
tools.description: Get the company the service account belongs to (name, subdomain, terminology). API: GET /companies/my_company.

tools.name: pingboard_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users (name, email, phone, job title, start date, reports-to id, group ids, custom fields). API: GET /users. Filters match exactly.

id.description: User id, or several ids separated by commas.

tools.name: pingboard_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one user by id, with groups, custom fields and linked accounts. API: GET /users/{id}.

id.description: Record id, from the matching list tool.

tools.name: pingboard_search_users
tools.title: Search users
tools.description: Search users by a free-text query (name, job title, skills, interests). API: GET /search/users?q=.

tools.name: pingboard_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List groups (teams, departments and other groups): name, description, type, member count. API: GET /groups.

id.description: Group id, or several ids separated by commas.

tools.name: pingboard_get_group
tools.title: Get a group
tools.description: Get one group by id, with its member user ids. API: GET /groups/{id}.

id.description: Record id, from the matching list tool.

tools.name: pingboard_search_groups
tools.title: Search groups
tools.description: Search groups by a free-text query. API: GET /search/groups?q=.

tools.name: pingboard_list_statuses
tools.title: List statuses
tools.description: List status entries (out-of-office and other status messages) with their time period. API: GET /statuses.

user_id.description: Only statuses of this user id.

tools.name: pingboard_get_status
tools.title: Get a status
tools.description: Get one status entry by id. API: GET /statuses/{id}.

id.description: Record id, from the matching list tool.

tools.name: pingboard_list_status_types
tools.title: List status types
tools.description: List the status types a company can use (name, slug, colour, availability). API: GET /status_types.

tools.name: pingboard_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom fields
tools.description: List the custom profile fields of the company (name, field type, valid values, visibility). API: GET /custom_fields.
